title: In Korea, the Government Invites You to a Checkup

slides.headline: In Korea, the government **invites you to a checkup.**
slides.note: For most adults, the basic exam costs nothing.

slides.headline: Every two years. **No bill.**
slides.body: The national health insurer invites most adults 20 and up for a general checkup (건강검진). The basic exam is free.

slides.headline: Your birth year **picks the year**
slides.body: Born in an even year? You go in even years. Odd, in odd years. Manual workers go every year.

slides.headline: Blood, vision, **even your teeth**
slides.body: Height, weight, blood pressure, blood and urine tests, a chest X-ray and a dental check, at a clinic you choose.

slides.headline: Turn 40: **a camera down your throat**
slides.body: From 40, a stomach endoscopy is offered every two years. Korea has some of the world's highest stomach cancer rates.

slides.headline: Many **sleep through it**
slides.body: Many pay extra for a sedated endoscopy (수면내시경). Cancer screenings cost about 10%, free for lower-income families.

slides.headline: Not when it hurts. **Before it does.**
slides.body: In many countries you see a doctor once something feels wrong. Here, the letter comes first.

slides.headline: Took their general checkup **in 2024**
slides.body: Cancer screening passed 60% for the first time.

slides.headline: Free to go. **Still easy to skip.**
slides.body: About one in four eligible people didn't go. The invite only works if you book it.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: Quiet clinic hallway at dawn, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, the national health insurer invites most adults to a free health checkup every two years.

Turn 40 and a stomach endoscopy joins the list, and many people choose to be sedated for it.

Who reminds you to get checked where you live?
reply: One more: the checkup year runs January to December, so clinics get packed every November and December as people rush before the deadline. Workers get paid time off for it, so many skip breakfast, spend the morning at the clinic and come back to work with a sleepy face after the sedated endoscopy. How do checkups work where you live, and who pays for them?
fact_check: 2장: 일반건강검진 2년 주기, 20세 이상 지역가입자·직장가입자·피부양자, 기본 항목 본인부담 없음 (2026 공단 안내 요약 블로그 다수, 공단 원문 미확인).
5장: 위암검진 만 40세 이상 2년마다(위내시경 또는 위장조영). 한국 위암 발생률 세계 최상위권(GLOBOCAN).
6장: 수면내시경 진정 비용 비급여(본인 추가부담). 암검진 본인부담 10%, 의료급여·보험료 하위 50% 무료.
8장: 2024 건강검진 통계연보 일반검진 수검률 75.6%, 암검진 60.2% 첫 60% 돌파 (헤럴드경제 2025-12-30 등 보도).
댓글: 검진기간 1/1~12/31, 연말 쏠림 — 매년 보도되는 패턴.
